meta.note: Queues allocate analyst attention. Numeric component scores are DIAGNOSTIC METADATA only, never an investment ranking. Ordering within Tier A is analyst judgment.

tier_criteria.tier_a: Not incidental, not established/beyond-stage, technical>=2, commercial>=2, relevance>=2, and latest signal within 24 months.
tier_criteria.tier_b: Relevant and not excluded, but missing one or two Tier A criteria.
tier_criteria.tier_c: Incidental, established/beyond-stage, dormant, or too little evidence.
tier_criteria.frontier: Pre-company signals. Separate framework; never compared numerically against funded companies.
